jobs.title: Specialist Programmer (Trainee)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Quick answer: Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 is now running on Naukri for two trainee roles, Specialist Programmer (Trainee) and Digital Specialist Engineer (Trainee), open to 2024, 2025 and 2026 UG/PG graduates with 0–2 years of experience. The old Infosys registration form has expired, so apply through the Naukri listings below ASAP.

Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 — job details at a glance Company Infosys Limited Roles Specialist Programmer (Trainee) · Digital Specialist Engineer (Trainee) Naukri job IDs SP 151026016759 · DSE 151026022319 Eligible batch 2024, 2025 and 2026 UG/PG graduates Experience 0–2 years Qualification BE/BTech (any branch); MTech, MCA, MS/MSc (any specialisation) Location Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi NCR (SP listing marked hybrid) Salary Official (Naukri): SP L1 ₹10 LPA + ₹1 lakh joining bonus, L2 ₹16 LPA, L3 ₹21 LPA; DSE ₹6.25 LPA + ₹75,000 joining bonus | Reported: SP ₹8–10 LPA, DSE ₹5.5–7 LPA (AmbitionBox) Openings 2,000 SP + 1,000 DSE Posted on Naukri 31 Oct 2026 · no closing date stated, apply ASAP Specialist Programmer (Trainee) on NaukriMain link · ID 151026016759 · 2,000 openingsDigital Specialist Engineer (Trainee) on NaukriID 151026022319 · 1,000 openings

Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 – full job details

The Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 has moved to Naukri. Infosys posted two fresh trainee listings from its official company page on 31 October 2026: one for Specialist Programmer (SP) and one for Digital Specialist Engineer (DSE). Both are aimed at engineers and postgraduates who completed their degree in 2024, 2025 or 2026 and have up to two years of work experience.

In the Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026, SP is the premium coding track with three pay levels, while DSE is the entry-level digital engineering role. Each listing carries its own Naukri ID and its own apply button, so choose the role that fits your coding strength, or apply to both if you qualify. Neither listing mentions a closing date.

Expired link removed: the earlier Infosys SP/DSE registration form on surveys.infosysapps.com now shows “The Survey is expired!”. Do not use it. The two Naukri listings are the only live routes for the Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 that we could verify on 25 November 2026.

Your SP level is not your choice: the SP listing names three levels (L1, L2, L3) but does not explain how candidates are placed. Expect it to depend on your test and interview, so the ₹21 LPA figure applies only to the top band.

Expected salary: For the Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026, the Naukri listings state ₹10 LPA plus a ₹1 lakh joining bonus for SP L1, ₹16 LPA for SP L2 and ₹21 LPA for SP L3. DSE trainees get ₹6.25 LPA plus a ₹75,000 joining bonus. Reported pay on AmbitionBox is lower: Infosys Specialist Programmer freshers report about ₹8–10 LPA (434 salaries), and the closest DSE match (Digital Engineer) is estimated at ₹5.5–7 LPA. Treat the Naukri figures as the offer and the reported ranges as a reality check.

What you will do in the Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 role

  • SP: build full-stack applications and enterprise platforms with modern frameworks, using AI in everyday engineering work
  • SP: write fast, clean and extensible code across object-oriented, procedural and scripting languages
  • SP: help create new client products and contribute to open-source and internal tech groups
  • DSE: turn functional and non-functional requirements into design, code and unit tests
  • DSE: run functional, integration and system validation, log defects and support go-live
  • DSE: work with stakeholders to resolve production issues
  • Skills named on Naukri: Java, Python, Scala, full-stack development, machine learning, React.js and big data

Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 eligibility

  • Batch: 2024, 2025 or 2026 UG/PG graduate
  • Experience: 0 to 2 years, so both freshers and early-career engineers can apply
  • UG: BTech/BE in any specialisation
  • PG: MTech, MCA or MS/MSc in any specialisation
  • Not stated on Naukri: percentage cut-off, backlog rule or education-gap rule

Unconfirmed: the expired Infosys form asked for an aggregate percentage worked out as a simple average of all subjects. The Naukri listings for the Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 do not repeat this rule, so treat it as unconfirmed for the current round and keep your marksheets ready.

Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 selection process

The Naukri listings for the Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 do not publish a selection process. The earlier Infosys registration round described a 3-hour in-person programming test followed by an in-person interview, so plan around that pattern:

  1. Coding assessment (about 3 hours): past SP/DSE cycles used problems of rising difficulty, so prepare for easy, medium and hard
  2. Technical interview: expect a walk-through of your code plus DSA, OOP, DBMS and your projects
  3. HR round: not confirmed; prepare a short self-introduction anyway

How to apply for Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026

  1. Open the Specialist Programmer (Trainee) listing on Naukri (ID 151026016759) or the Digital Specialist Engineer (Trainee) listing (ID 151026022319)
  2. Log in to Naukri and press Apply; make sure your batch, degree and experience are correct on your profile
  3. Apply to both listings if you qualify, since they are separate requisitions
  4. Save a screenshot of the applied status and watch your email and Naukri inbox for the test invite
  5. Never pay anyone for a slot; Infosys does not charge a fee

About Infosys

Infosys, the company behind the Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026, is a Bengaluru-headquartered IT services and consulting firm that serves clients in dozens of countries. It hires thousands of freshers every year through campus and off-campus routes, and the SP and DSE tracks are its better-paying options for strong coders.
